status: model of the account Worker built from subnet/account-worker (slop-ninja-account), with one Durable Object class (QuotaLimiter). The JS reserve, glue sizes and stack are the coordinator model's inputs (the same workers-rs 0.8.7, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions, the same hand-written export pattern), not measured on this Worker yet, so the build uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature together with observe (migration step 1) and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below. Every request body is read with a bound fixed per route (memory::BODY_BYTES, OP_BODY_BYTES) and every provider answer with auth-core's bounds; the route footprints below are the fixed parts, each a stated margin until measured (memory.rs).
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the coordinator model's value (a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages), kept so the models share one unmeasured JS reserve until this Worker's is measured through the inspector
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: the largest body this Worker holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory is one chunk of a request or provider answer (the bounded readers hold one chunk at a time), rounded up to one page of headroom
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; this crate's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions. This Worker has no lazy statics of its own
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker's hand-written fetch, scheduled and Durable Object exports (cf.rs) follows the probe's admitted pattern
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance, rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker defines one Durable Object class (QuotaLimiter, one instance per quota bucket key)
min_route_bytes_source: the smallest route control footprint: the 404 route's and a QuotaLimiter call's (memory::SMALL_CONTROL_BYTES, one page), checked by memory::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
largest_route_bytes_source: the list routes' control footprint (memory::LIST_CONTROL_BYTES: account views, export, signed ops) plus the scope's state page; checked by memory::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind), a lower bound
